observations.metric: RNA Hallmark ssGSEA: significant_q05 / tested_count
observations.finding: 21 of 50 Hallmark pathways are significant at BH-q<0.05 (min q=0.00115), indicating a broad, organized transcriptional difference for C0001 versus rest.

observations.metric: RNA top pathway HALLMARK_HEME_METABOLISM (SMD, direction, set/rest medians, q)
observations.finding: SMD=-0.861 (down), set median 0.293 vs rest 0.323, q=0.00115; the strongest RNA effect is a lower heme-metabolism score in C0001.

observations.metric: RNA top pathway HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION (SMD, direction, q)
observations.finding: SMD=+0.827 (up), set median 0.440 vs rest 0.393, q=0.004375; EMT score is higher in C0001.

observations.metric: WXS PBRM1 enrichment (freq diff, OR, 95% CI, Fisher p, q)
observations.finding: PBRM1 mutation frequency 0.571 vs 0.279 (delta 0.292; OR 3.44, 95% CI 1.46-8.07; Fisher p=0.0053) but BH-q=0.116; no WXS feature reaches q<0.05 (0/22 significant).

observations.metric: CNV continuous CDKN2A (Cliff's delta, direction, q)
observations.finding: CDKN2A copy number is lower in C0001 (delta=-0.533, q=0.00076); 12 of 49 continuous CNV features are significant.

observations.metric: CNV gain/loss CDKN2A::loss (freq diff, OR, 95% CI, q)
observations.finding: CDKN2A loss frequency 0.429 vs 0.147 (delta 0.282; OR 4.35, 95% CI 1.69-11.22; q=0.0339); 2 of 107 gain/loss features are significant.

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: C0001 shows a coherent RNA signal with many FDR-significant Hallmark pathways and moderate-to-large SMDs. WXS shows a nominal PBRM1 enrichment that does not survive FDR. CNV shows significant continuous and gain/loss differences, notably CDKN2A loss and chr9p/9q loss. The modalities are not equally strong: RNA and CNV are FDR-supported, WXS is only nominal. Availability is complete (set n=35, rest n=68 for RNA; comparable for WXS/CNV).
biological_support.medical_interpretation: The pattern is consistent with a biologically distinct group characterized by lower heme-metabolism and higher EMT/DNA-repair transcriptional programs, together with CDKN2A copy loss. These are descriptive molecular associations; no prognostic or mechanistic claim is made.
limitations: WXS enrichment is not FDR-significant.
RNA and CNV findings are relative to the rest of this partition and do not establish an external subtype taxonomy.
Effect sizes are moderate and based on a single partition.
